description: This file defines the ReporterV2 interface and its implementation, ReporterV2Wrapper, for handling test reporting in the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for various test lifecycle events, error handling, and output streaming, as well as a utility to wrap reporters as version 2.

classes.name: ReporterV2Wrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing the ReporterV2 interface, delegating calls to an underlying Reporter instance and handling deferred output.

methods.name: wrapReporterAsV2
methods.description: Function to wrap a Reporter or ReporterV2 instance as a ReporterV2.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string 'v2' indicating the reporter version.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the reporter.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test suite; forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Called when a test begins; forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles standard output chunks; buffers if deferred.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error chunks; buffers if deferred.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Called when a test ends; forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of test run; forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Handles process exit; forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test step; forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of a test step; forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates if the reporter prints to stdio; defaults to true if not specified.
